items.summary: CFO recommendation: reject all three new scaffold change requests and admit no new implementation this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Revenue claims are not supported: Amazon's 2026-09-21 report shows 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, but all commission is under aggregate tracking ID "other" and cannot be assigned to a site. Site-attributed commission is $0. Contribution margin, ROI, and budget exposure are not calculable because monthly fixed costs, infrastructure/domain costs, marketing spend, labor allocation, and site-level revenue mapping are absent. AI spend is $2.2785467 across 16 calls on 2026-10-01, instrumented for only 4 of 38 expected sites; average cost per call is $0.14240916875, but cost-to-learn is not calculable because calls are not linked to a defined learning unit or verified outcome. The only partial observed result is saveusfarms.com AI cost of $0.3480626 against $0 attributed revenue, excluding all other costs. Preserve the canonical repair-or-close case and the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after capacity and overlap clearance; do not claim revenue, margin, ROI, causal lift, or forecast upside.

Minimum finance measurement before any economic claim: reconcile provider orders, shipped items, commission, and tracking IDs to each site/content identifier for the same reporting period; maintain a site-level cost ledger covering AI, hosting/infrastructure, domains, tooling, and authorized marketing; and link each implementation's cost, exposure window, affiliate clicks, orders, shipped items, and commission. For cost-to-learn, additionally define the learning unit and link AI calls to that unit and a verified outcome. Until these fields exist, report revenue only as aggregate unattributed provider data and margin/ROI as unknown.
